title: Autonomous Detection of Polypharmacy-Induced Acute Kidney Injury in Nigeria Using Multi-Source Real-World Data: An AI Agent's Approach

contributions.purpose: 构建自主完成药物流行病学研究的AI智能体架构
contributions.mechanism: 六模块流水线(文献综合/数据摄取/假设生成/研究设计/数据分析/报告),LLM负责推理与写作,Python做数据处理与统计,记录prompt/代码/随机种子,人类监督
contributions.evaluation: 定性:demonstrate了端到端可行性,产出完整手稿
contributions.domain: 药物流行病学/AI科研智能体
contributions.source_quote: We propose an agent architecture that orchestrates literature synthesis, data ingestion, hypothesis generation, study design, statistical analysis and reporting within a single pipeline.

contributions.purpose: 融合结构化与非结构化多源数据
contributions.mechanism: 将处方claims与自由文本临床笔记映射到OMOP通用数据模型,NLP(NER+规则分类器)抽取AKI提及并按时间戳关联结构化就诊
contributions.evaluation: 定性:统一框架下处理异质性并保护隐私(标识符本地化,仅共享聚合结果)
contributions.source_quote: We develop a data integration framework that maps both structured claims and unstructured clinical notes to the Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership (OMOP) common data model.

contributions.purpose: 合成数据案例验证更早的安全信号检测
contributions.mechanism: 50000名降压药起始者(8500人30天内用抗疟药),对10个降压-抗疟组合算OR/IC/lead time,结构化数据vs整合数据对比
contributions.evaluation: 4组合高风险,如Lisinopril+蒿甲醚-苯芴醇OR2.5(95%CI1.8-3.5),IC下界0.9,早3个月检出;整合笔记使recall 0.55→0.80、F1 0.45→0.67(precision不变);第4组Enalapril+ivermectin关联弱且无提前量(null)
contributions.source_quote: the agent detects high-risk drug combinations and identifies signals earlier than analyses based on structured data alone.

contributions.mechanism: 记录AI与人类贡献、伦理考量、可复现细节
contributions.source_quote: We document AI and human contributions, ethical considerations and reproducibility details to comply with the Agents4Science submission requirements.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our work answers this call by constructing an agent that autonomously executes a full pharmacoepidemiologic study.

notes: 数据可信度核心红旗:全部'结果'(OR/IC/lead time/高风险组合/临床建议)均基于智能体自己生成的合成数据,无任何真实数据验证——所谓'安全信号'与'更早检出'是自造数据的产物,却在4.5节给出'避免ACE抑制剂+青蒿素类'的可操作临床建议(潜在误导)。作者对合成性质披露充分(摘要/限制节反复声明),诚信度尚可。含内部null结果(第4组Enalapril+ivermectin关联弱、无提前量;且ivermectin严格说非抗疟药)。标注不一致:Table1组合编号1-4,正文却用'combinations B and C''combination D'字母指代。引用红旗:Zheng et al. 2025的PubMed URL为.../47355013/,PMID位数异常偏高(现役约3900万级),疑幻觉/伪造PMID;Golder(39786481)、Toh(29314770)PMID则合理。AI披露:四项(假设/设计/分析/写作)均[C](AI主导+人类监督)。self_declared限制节承认智能体在因果推断/混杂调整上需人类指导。
